issue.title: Provided MAVLink headers are installed to the wrong directory
issue.body:
When supplying MAVLink C-header files and building from source, the build system installs the headers to a location that's not able to be found by `mavlink_include.h`.

Ubuntu 18.04 LTS
CMake v3.24.3

Configuration:
`cmake -B build/default -S . -DMAVLINK_DIALECT=all -DMAVLINK_HEADERS=../my_headers -H.`

Build and Install:
`sudo cmake --build build/default --target install -j8`

Resulting directory structure:
`/usr/local/include/mavsdk/plugins/mavlink_passthrough/**my_headers**/mavlink/v2.0/...`

Include line from `mavlink_passthrough/mavlink_include.h`:
`#include "mavlink/v2.0/all/mavlink.h`

---

To fix this, I edited `mavsdk/src/mavsdk/plugins/mavlink_passthrough/CMakeLists.txt`:
```
install(DIRECTORY
    ${MAVLINK_HEADERS} --> ${MAVLINK_HEADERS}/mavlink
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/mavsdk/plugins/mavlink_passthrough
)
```

---

Please let me know if I'm doing something incorrectly. If I'm not, please update that `install(...)` command in the next release. Thanks! :)

@julianoes I checked out `v1.4.8` and did an install on a clean system, but it looks like the issue is still there. Any thoughts? :)
Ok, so I broke it a second time :astonished:

Unfortunately, no :frowning_face:   To summarize:
- v1.4.6 copies the parent directory of the custom MAVLink headers instead of the `mavlink/` folder
- v1.4.7 copies the correct `mavlink/` folder, but to a location that's inaccessible to `mavlink_passthrough`

`cmake -B build/default -S . -DMAVLINK_DIALECT=all -DMAVLINK_HEADERS=../my_headers -H.`
